use_case: DC Network Policy Controller for ACI (Application Centric Infrastructure)
notes: Centralized SDN controller for ACI fabric. Deployed as 3-node cluster. Controls Nexus 9000 switches in ACI mode. Policy-driven DC automation. ACI-mode NX-OS is a separate version track (16.x) from standalone NX-OS (10.x).

example_pids: N9K-C9336C-FX2, N9K-C93180YC-EX, N9K-C9504 (same hardware as standalone)
notes: Same Nexus 9000 hardware as standalone NX-OS but running ACI-mode firmware. Managed exclusively by APIC. ACI-mode and standalone NX-OS are mutually exclusive — cannot mix on same node.
Fixed-config SAN switches. 9132T: 32-port 32G FC; 9148T: 48-port 32G FC; 9148V: 48-port FC + NVMe-oF. Common in small-medium DC SAN deployments.
Modular 1-slot SAN switch with integrated FC and FCIP. Designed for IP-connected storage. Fixed 2U form factor.
96-port 32G FC fixed-config SAN switches. 9396V adds NVMe-oF support. High-density 2U platform for mid-to-large SAN fabrics.
Modular director-class SAN switches. 6-, 10-, and 18-slot chassis. Supports 32G FC and NVMe-oF line cards. FICON qualified. High availability dual supervisor.
Half-width / full-width blade servers housed in UCS 5108 chassis. Managed by UCS Manager or Intersight. B200 M7 uses 4th Gen Intel Xeon. Requires UCS Fabric Interconnect.
Industry-standard rack servers. C220: 1U 2-socket; C240: 2U storage-optimised. Can be managed standalone via CIMC, in UCS domain via UCSM, or via Intersight. M7 = 4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable.

product_series: X9508 Chassis / X210c M7 / X410c M7
notes: Next-generation modular system replacing UCS B-Series. X9508 is 7U chassis. Compute nodes are X210c (2-socket) or X410c (4-socket). Designed for Intersight-managed hybrid cloud. Requires UCS 6536 FI.
Top-of-rack FI for UCS B/C-Series domains. 6454: 54-port (40x 25G + 14x 40/100G); 6464: 64-port. Runs UCS Manager. Required for UCS blade and rack server domains.
Next-gen FI designed for UCS X-Series. 36-port 400G. Runs UCSM 6.0. Required for UCS X-Series compute nodes. Can also manage legacy C/B-Series.
2-socket all-flash / hybrid HCI node. Runs VMware vSphere or Cisco HyperFlex Application Platform (HXAP). Minimum 3-node cluster. Managed via Intersight or HX Connect.
2U 2-socket high-storage-density HCI node. Greater disk bay count than HX220c. Used for data-intensive workloads. Managed via Intersight.
HyperFlex Edge is a 2-node HCI configuration for remote/branch deployments without a Fabric Interconnect. Managed by Intersight from HQ.
Nexus Dashboard Orchestrator (formerly Multi-Site Orchestrator / MSO). Manages ACI policy across multiple APIC sites, on-prem and cloud. Runs on Cisco Nexus Dashboard platform.
